The second OR branch in the deleteMany query is missing a method guard, so it will delete any WorkflowReminder with retryCount > 1, not just SMS reminders - the cleanup should be scoped to SMS only

Using JavaScript-level addition (reminder.retryCount + 1) instead of Prisma's atomic increment operator creates race conditions when two scheduler instances run concurrently, causing one failure to be lost and weakening the delete after two failures logic

The Twilio provider API call and database persistence are in a single try-catch, so if Twilio accepts the SMS but the database update fails, the error is treated as a send failure causing duplicate SMS on retry
After multiple database failures, the reminder row may be deleted leaving orphaned jobs on Twilio with no database reference
